issues.on_page: Solid Waste 969.00 (General Fund column, under Business-Type Activities line 45)
issues.issue: Solid Waste is printed in the business-type section but in the General Fund column; kept governmental by column (also detail General Fund Solid Waste). Defensible, but a person may prefer business-type since the village has a Water & Sewer fund that carries the rest of Solid Waste (19,538.00).
